name: UPI PIN entry demanded outside a payment the user is making
description: The recipient is prompted to enter their UPI PIN for verification, KYC or to 'receive' — outside a payment they themselves are making. A UPI PIN is only ever needed to send money.

manual_retrieval.notes: Original NPCI PDF was HTTP 403 under automated retrieval; manually verified. 'Only sending money requires UPI PIN.'

explanation.plain: You were asked to enter your UPI PIN to 'verify', complete KYC or receive money. Your UPI PIN is only ever needed to SEND money. Any other reason is a scam.
explanation.technical: UPI_PIN_PROMPT (credential-action) with a non-payment pretext. NPCI: only sending money requires a UPI PIN.
verification_steps: Only enter your UPI PIN when you are deliberately sending a payment.
Ignore any 'verify/KYC/receive' request that needs your UPI PIN.
explanation.why_confidence_limited: Evidence is NPCI's manually-retrieved guideline (PRIMARY, MR-EVID-002); the RBI half of the original basis did not list UPI-PIN (D1), so the rule is capped at PARTIAL.

provenance.notes: Encoded in the WP3 rule-encoding pass; suppression via negative-indicator-library-v1.json.
